component.name: TVDeck
component.summary: A streaming deck experience for your SteamOS machine

description.p: A controller-first launcher for streaming services on Steam Deck and Steam Machine. Each service opens in a lightweight browser view you can drive entirely from a gamepad, with player shortcuts for pausing, seeking, skipping intros and frame-by-frame stepping.
TVDeck is not affiliated with or endorsed by any streaming service. You need your own account for each service.
